title: INmune Bio Establishes Global Commercialization Framework for Ebstrocel™ Through Strategic Agreement with Uniphar
summary: A leading biotechnology company focused on modulating components of the innate immune system to activate a response against cancer and Alzheimers.
body_markdown:
***Initial focus on named-patient access in selected European and MENA markets, providing a capital-efficient foundation for broader commercialization***


BOCA RATON, Fla., Oct. 21, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- INmune Bio Inc. (NASDAQ: INMB) (the “Company”), a late-stage biotechnology company focused on inflammation and immunology, today announced that it has entered into a Master Services Agreement with Uniphar Durbin Ireland Limited (“Uniphar”) establishing a scalable framework to support international access, distribution and commercialization of Ebstrocel™, the Company’s allogeneic stromal cell therapy for Recessive Dystrophic Epidermolysis Bullosa (RDEB). INmune Bio initially intends to use the framework to pursue named-patient access in selected European countries and in the Middle East and North Africa (MENA), subject to applicable law and country-specific statements of work. The relationship may subsequently expand across Europe and other territories by mutual agreement.


The Company expects named-patient access to be an important component of its international commercialization strategy for Ebstrocel™. Where permitted by local law and implemented through statements of work, this pathway may allow physicians to request Ebstrocel™ for individual eligible patients before local marketing approval or broad commercial availability.


The Uniphar framework is designed to provide the Company with scalable international commercial infrastructure, beginning with named-patient supply, and potentially expanding to broader commercial distribution as regulatory approvals, pricing and reimbursement are secured in individual countries. Depending on the services agreed in individual statements of work, Uniphar may support regulatory feasibility assessments, market access, product storage and distribution, healthcare-provider and treatment-site onboarding, order-to-cash services, medical information, pharmacovigilance support and end-to-end shipment tracking. By leveraging Uniphar’s established infrastructure rather than building country-by-country capabilities internally, the Company believes this model provides a capital-efficient path to establish Ebstrocel™’s international commercial footprint and scale as additional markets become available.


“This agreement marks an important step in moving Ebstrocel™ from clinical development toward commercialization and bringing Ebstrocel to patients internationally,” said David Moss, Chief Executive Officer of INmune Bio. “Uniphar provides access to established market-access, distribution and order-to-cash capabilities across multiple international markets without requiring INmune Bio to build those capabilities country by country. We believe this provides a capital-efficient way to pursue named-patient opportunities in appropriate markets while building the physician relationships, treatment-center experience and commercial infrastructure needed to support broader international commercialization.”


“We are pleased to partner with INmune Bio as it prepares Ebstrocel for international commercialization,” said Ruth Rostron, Head of Expanded Access at Uniphar. “Uniphar has built an integrated global platform to help innovative medicines navigate the complexities of international access, distribution and commercialization. We believe our infrastructure and experience are well suited to support INmune Bio’s strategy for Ebstrocel, beginning with named-patient access opportunities and expanding as the product progresses through its regulatory and commercial journey.”


**About Ebstrocel™**


Ebstrocel™ ( *pobistrocel* ) is INmune Bio’s investigational, pooled, allogeneic, human umbilical cord-derived mesenchymal stromal cell therapy being developed through the Company’s CORDStrom™ platform for the treatment of RDEB. The platform is designed to address donor variability and manufacturing inconsistency. Ebstrocel™ is investigational and has not been approved by the FDA, MHRA, EMA or any other regulatory authority.


**About Uniphar Plc.**


Uniphar is a trusted global partner to pharma, medtech and biotech, delivering solutions that connect medicines and technologies with patients worldwide. With over 57 years of experience and partnerships with 200+ multinational clients, Uniphar combines deep expertise, global infrastructure and market insight to meet the evolving needs of the life sciences sector.


Uniphar Pharma integrates Development, Clinical, Access, Medical, Commercial, Distribution and Global Sourcing to support the full product lifecycle – from early-stage research through to commercialization and beyond. Uniphar’s unified platform spans regulatory strategy, clinical trial support, medical affairs, market access, patient engagement, commercial services, distribution and supply chain.


Operating across 160 countries with a global team of 3,600+, Uniphar bridges manufacturers, healthcare providers, and patients — accelerating access to innovative therapies, improving patient outcomes, and delivering value across the healthcare ecosystem.


From molecule to market and beyond.

**About INmune Bio Inc.**


INmune Bio Inc. is a publicly traded (NASDAQ: INMB), late-stage biotechnology company focused on developing treatments that target the innate immune system to fight disease. Moving beyond early-stage exploration, the Company’s clinical-development strategy centers on advanced precision medicine, matching drug mechanisms directly to patient biology to optimize clinical outcomes.


INmune Bio is actively advancing two late-stage product platforms toward registrational milestones:


- CORDStrom™: A proprietary, pooled, allogeneic, human umbilical cord-derived mesenchymal stromal cell platform engineered to address the historical clinical challenges of donor variability and manufacturing inconsistency. Following successful clinical readouts in RDEB, the platform is transitioning toward regulatory and commercial readiness, with an MAA planned for the UK MHRA in 2026 and EU EMA in 2027, alongside a planned U.S. regulatory pathway and development of international access and distribution infrastructure.


- XPro1595™: A Dominant-Negative Tumor Necrosis Factor (DN-TNF) platform that selectively neutralizes soluble TNF (sTNF) to reduce pathological neuroinflammation without compromising protective immune function. Backed by recently granted FDA Fast Track designation and successful regulatory alignment from an End-of-Phase 2 meeting, XPro1595™ is positioned for an integrated Phase 2b/3 seamless adaptive registrational program in neuroinflammation-enriched early Alzheimer’s disease.
